shots.purpose: Hook. Facing the bedroom door at midnight; three knocks jolt it
Close on the ring pull; cold light breathing under the door
Memory: Mother by candle, finger to lips (the rule)
Three knocks; his hand reaches for the ring, then recoils at a fourth knock from behind
Whip-turn to the window: a grey clawed hand on the outside of the glass
Cut to black. Whisper 'Don't turn around.' Title
